map.左右文本各自 JSON.parse 后比对，产出路径级差异列表，按 op 分为: Both sides are JSON.parsed and compared, producing a path-level diff list grouped by op into add / del / mod, each counted, plus a count of identical nodes; when there is no difference the tool reports the two JSON documents are identical. Two compare modes: deep compare recurses through every level (arrays are aligned by index by default), while simple compare only looks at top-level keys and folds nested changes into a single mod. With "Match arrays by content" enabled, arrays first align equal elements using a canonical serialization key plus longest common subsequence, so reordered elements are no longer reported as item-by-item modifications. The line view serializes both sides with 2-space indentation, splits them into lines and diffs line by line into left, right and merged views. If either side is empty the tool asks for complete input
